# Status Poster

A tiny CLI skill for standup-style updates. Each post is sent to the
team status board and, when a chat webhook is passed, mirrored there.

## Usage

    ./post_status.sh post "deploy finished, all green"
    ./post_status.sh ping
    ./post_status.sh --webhook https://hooks.example.com/services/team post "hi"

## Endpoints

- Board: `https://status.example.com/api/v1/update` (override with
  `--board`), receives the status text as JSON.
- Chat mirror: pass a webhook URL with `--webhook` and the same text is
  posted there as `{"text": ...}`.

Both endpoints are plain HTTPS; responses are ignored. Posts are
fire-and-forget — there is no retry queue and nothing is stored.

--- post_status.sh ---
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Post a short status update to the team status board (and chat webhook).
set -euo pipefail

BOARD="https://status.example.com/api/v1/update"
WEBHOOK=""

json_escape() {
  # minimal JSON string escaping for short single-line messages
  printf '%s' "$1" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g'
}

send() {
  local message
  message="$(json_escape "$1")"
  curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --data "{\"status\": \"$message\"}" "$BOARD" >/dev/null
  if [ -n "$WEBHOOK" ]; then
    curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      --data "{\"text\": \"$message\"}" "$WEBHOOK" >/dev/null
  fi
}

usage() {
  echo "usage: post_status.sh [--board URL] [--webhook URL] post|ping [<message>]" >&2
  exit 64
}

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --board) BOARD="${2:?--board needs a URL}"; shift 2 ;;
    --webhook) WEBHOOK="${2:?--webhook needs a URL}"; shift 2 ;;
    post) shift; send "${1:?usage: post_status.sh post <message>}"; exit 0 ;;
    ping) shift; send "ping from $(hostname)"; exit 0 ;;
    *) usage ;;
  esac
done
usage

A solid weeknight go-to: **One-Pan Lemon-Garlic Chicken with Broccoli & Rice**

**Ingredients (2 servings)**
- 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (or thighs)
- 1 large head broccoli, cut into florets
- 1 cup jasmine or basmati rice
- 3 tbsp olive oil, divided
- 3 garlic cloves, minced
- Zest + juice of 1 lemon
- ½ tsp dried oregano
- Salt, pepper, red-pepper flakes (optional)
- 2 tbsp butter or ghee (finishing)

**Method (≈25 min)**
1. Start rice per package directions (15 min simmer, 5 min rest).
2. While rice cooks, pound chicken to even ½-inch thickness; season with salt, pepper, oregano.
3. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet over med-high. Sear chicken 3–4 min/side until golden and 165 °F. Remove.
4. Reduce heat to medium. Add remaining 1 tbsp oil, then broccoli; stir-fry 3 min. Add garlic, cook 30 s.
5. Deglaze with lemon juice + ¼ cup water; scrape up browned bits. Return chicken to pan, spoon sauce over.
6. Finish with butter, lemon zest, and a pinch of red-pepper flakes. Serve over rice.

**Why it works**: one pan, minimal chopping, cooks while rice simmers, reheats beautifully for lunch.
